name: code-hierarchy
description: A live function and class hierarchy docked beside your code, with instant fuzzy search. No sidebar, no clicking around.

codeHierarchy.autoOpen.markdownDescription: Open the hierarchy panel automatically beside your code the first time you focus a source file in a window. Turn this off to open it yourself with **Code Hierarchy: Open Hierarchy Panel**.

codeHierarchy.followCursor.description: Highlight the symbol containing the editor cursor in the panel as you move around the file.

codeHierarchy.functionsOnly.description: Show only functions, methods and constructors, plus the containers that hold them. The panel toolbar toggles this too.

enumDescriptions: Keep symbols in the order they appear in the file.
Sort symbols alphabetically within each level.
codeHierarchy.sortOrder.description: Order in which sibling symbols are listed. Ignored while a search is active, where results are ranked by match quality.

codeHierarchy.showDetail.description: Show the signature detail reported by the language server next to each symbol.

codeHierarchy.showLineNumbers.description: Append the starting line number to each symbol.

codeHierarchy.refreshDelay.description: Milliseconds to wait after you stop typing before rebuilding the hierarchy.

codeHierarchy.useFallbackParser.description: When no language server provides symbols, scan the file with the built-in pattern parser. Results are marked as approximate.

codeHierarchy.showStatusBar.description: Show the path of the enclosing symbol in the status bar.

codeHierarchy.highlightOnReveal.description: Briefly flash the symbol in the editor when you click it in the tree.

scripts.test: npm run check-types && npm run lint && npm run compile-tests && npm run test:unit
scripts.test:all: npm run test && npm run test:integration
scripts.pretest: npm run compile && npm run compile-tests

untrustedWorkspaces.description: Code Hierarchy only reads open documents and asks VS Code for their symbols. It runs no workspace code and makes no network requests.
